ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes, stores or has access to data of Corio or its Customers, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance upon request.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant (existing 14.10 to be renumbered), since Commerce One supplies on-site consultants and professional services and its service handles data of Corio and its Customers. Our position is CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M; we can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in Miscellaneous
